description: This Java source file defines the `RetrieveConnectionLogsResponse` class, which models the response to a connectivity log retrieval command in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating, parsing from JSON, serializing to JSON, and merging responses, along with encapsulating connection log entries and timestamp information.

classes.name: RetrieveConnectionLogsResponse
classes.description: Represents the response to a command for retrieving connection logs, encapsulating connection IDs, log entries, and optional timestamps for log enabling periods. Implements JSON serialization/deserialization and response merging functionalities.

classes.name: RetrieveConnectionLogsResponse.JsonFields
classes.description: Contains definitions of JSON field names used in serializing and deserializing the response object.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of RetrieveConnectionLogsResponse with provided connection ID, logs, timestamps, and headers.

methods.name: mergeRetrieveConnectionLogsResponse
methods.description: Merges two response instances into one, combining logs and preserving timestamps and headers of the first.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Parses a JSON string or object to produce a RetrieveConnectionLogsResponse instance.

methods.name: getRetrieveConnectionLogsResponse
methods.description: Internal method to construct a response object from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: parseInstantOrNull
methods.description: Extracts and parses an ISO-8601 Instant from a JSON object field, or returns null if absent.

methods.name: tryToParseInstant
methods.description: Attempts to parse a string into an Instant, throwing a JsonParseException on failure.

methods.name: parseConnectionLogs
methods.description: Extracts connection log entries from a JSON object array.
